blocking_quality_finding.detail: SC03-SC05 establish the mother sea dragon in the lighthouse upper room / at the top of the narrow stair. Accepted SC06 reintroduces her as a broad shadow crossing the doorway and says she pushes head and shoulders into the upper room while the rest cannot fit through a narrow way. This contradicts the immediately prior spatial continuity.
evidence: SC05: its mother waited above, unable to squeeze down the narrow stair.
SC06: A broad shadow crossed the doorway.
SC06: The mother sea dragon pushed her head and shoulders into the upper room, unable to force the rest of her body through the narrow way.
blocking_quality_finding.root_cause: StoryState does not carry mother_dragon location, so writer and semantic guard lacked authoritative mutable entity-location truth. Character canon and prop policy do not cover this state dimension.

decision: Preserve Q7 evidence as rejected qualification. Add mother dragon location to structured relay state in a fresh SC03 qualification, then rerun SC04-SC06 from that corrected accepted state. Do not patch or rewrite the already accepted Q7 artifacts.
